rules.statement: The burden of proving the testator's mental competency at the time of making a will shifts to the objector if there is nothing intrinsically unnatural in the document and it has been duly executed.
rules.supporting_quote: If, after proof of due execution, there is nothing intrinsically unnatural in the document, the burden is shifted to the objector to show that there was undue influence or fraud or that the deceased was not of a sound disposing mind when he made the will.
